name: Anicons – Chat Button & Scroll to Top
author: Farith Adhil

sections.description:
Anicons is a lightweight WordPress plugin that adds an animated WhatsApp Chat Button and a Scroll-to-Top button to your website.

It helps visitors contact you instantly via WhatsApp and improves navigation — without slowing down your site.

Perfect for:

✅ WooCommerce stores

✅ Local businesses

✅ Service providers & freelancers

✅ Small business blogs that rely on WhatsApp leads

📺 Video tutorial:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kC2qM2_g8lk

Best For

🛒 WooCommerce Stores

Answer pre-sale questions instantly

Reduce cart abandonment

Increase customer trust with WhatsApp support

🏪 Local Businesses

One-tap WhatsApp contact on mobile

Ideal for salons, clinics, shops, restaurants

👨‍💼 Service Providers

Freelancers, consultants, agencies

Convert visitors into WhatsApp leads

No complex setup required

WhatsApp Chat Button Features

✅ Opens WhatsApp Web on desktop
✅ Opens WhatsApp app on mobile (Android & iOS)
✅ Supports WhatsApp & WhatsApp Business numbers
✅ Floating sticky button (left or right position)
✅ Clean animated icons
✅ Mobile-friendly and responsive

Scroll to Top Button Features

✅ Sticky scroll-to-top button
✅ Appears automatically on scroll
✅ Multiple icon styles
✅ Adjustable position and spacing

Performance & Optimization

Lightweight and fast-loading

No jQuery dependency

Minimal CSS & JavaScript

Compatible with caching plugins

No negative impact on Google PageSpeed

Translations

Available languages:

English

How to Use

Activate the plugin

WhatsApp Chat Button and Scroll-to-Top Button will appear automatically

Go to Anicons Settings to:

Add your WhatsApp number

Enable or disable buttons

Adjust position and spacing

Note:
WhatsApp button will appear only after a valid mobile number is added.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

Go to Plugins → Add New

Search for Anicons – WhatsApp Chat Button & Scroll to Top

Click Install Now, then Activate

Manual Installation

Download the plugin ZIP file

Upload to /wp-content/plugins/anicons-chat-scroll-to-top/

Activate via WordPress dashboard
sections.faq:
How do I set up the plugin?

Video Tutorial

How do I add my WhatsApp number?

Go to Anicons Settings in the WordPress admin and enter your WhatsApp number.

WhatsApp button not showing?

Ensure the plugin is activated

Enter a valid WhatsApp number

Clear cache (browser & site)

Check button position settings

Does this work with WooCommerce?

Yes. It works perfectly with WooCommerce websites.
sections.changelog:
1.3.1

Improved plugin SEO and WordPress.org visibility

Optimized descriptions for WooCommerce and business websites

Updated screenshots with real-world use cases

Minor UI and animation improvements
= 1.3.0=
Updated Animated icons and fixed WhatsApp opening on apple mobile devices.
= 1.2.0=
Updated icons and fixed WhatsApp opening on mobile devices.
= 1.1.3=
New Icons Updated
= 1.1.2=
Enhanced WhatsApp link handling: Now intelligently opens WhatsApp Web on desktop, and the WhatsApp app on both iOS and Android devices for a seamless user experience.
Improved security: User agent is now properly sanitized and validated, and all input handling is stricter to meet WordPress security standards.
Modernized settings UI: The “Enable WhatsApp Icon” and “Enable Scroll-to-Top Icon” options now use toggle switches for a more intuitive and visually appealing admin experience.
Better WhatsApp number validation: Admin guidance and input validation have been improved to help ensure only valid numbers are saved.

1.1.1

Added toggle switches to enable or disable the WhatsApp and Scroll-to-Top icons.
Introduced additional static and animated icon options for greater customization.

1.1.0

Added a toggle button to allow moving the WhatsApp Sticky Button to the right side of the screen.

1.0.0

Initial release featuring a floating WhatsApp Sticky Button and a Scroll-to-Top Button.
